title: Security Command Center: findings, posture and what to act on first

videos.script: A public bucket. An open firewall. A vulnerable machine. A permission granted at three in the morning. {{list}} Security Command Center puts them in one list. Each finding is one problem, on one resource, with a severity and a state. {{finding}} Severity is where triage starts, not where it ends. Something muted, or already fixed, drops out. {{triage}} And one kind jumps the queue. A threat finding says something may be happening now. That is an incident, not a ticket. {{threat}} Fixing findings one by one keeps a project clean for a week. Taking away the permission to create them keeps it clean for good. {{posture}}
